# TradingView Lightweight Charts™

- Package: `lightweight-charts` 5.2.1 (npm), used by the web chart (`apps/web/src/charts/CandleChart.tsx`, a lazy chunk)
- License: Apache License 2.0, copy in `lightweight-charts-LICENSE.txt`
- Attribution notice: TradingView Lightweight Charts™ Copyright (c) 2025 TradingView, Inc. https://www.tradingview.com/
- The package README asks users to show this notice and a link to https://www.tradingview.com/ on a page users can see.
  The chart keeps the `attributionLogo` option on (the TradingView logo links to tradingview.com) and the chart panel
  shows the notice with the link under the chart.
